title: À propos de Nice
creator: Jean Vigo
description: Jean Vigo’s silent short, made at 25, sets the idle rich on the Promenade and in the casinos against the poor streets of the old town. A sharp, funny piece of social satire.

title: Children of Paradise
creator: Marcel Carné
description: Les Enfants du paradis: a romance set in the theaters of 1820s Paris, filmed mostly at the Victorine studios in Nice during the German occupation. It is often named the greatest French film.

title: To Catch a Thief
creator: Alfred Hitchcock
description: Cary Grant plays a retired jewel thief on the Riviera, accused of new robberies, with Grace Kelly as an American heiress. A chase runs through the flower market on the Cours Saleya.

title: Bay of Angels
creator: Jacques Demy
description: La Baie des Anges: a young bank clerk falls for a reckless gambler, played by Jeanne Moreau, in the casinos of Nice. The title is the name of the bay the city curves around.

title: Day for Night
creator: François Truffaut
description: La Nuit américaine: Truffaut’s affectionate film about making a film, shot at the Victorine studios in Nice. It won the Oscar for best foreign language film.
